You are working on a Rocq formalization project at /scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian.

**Goal:** Eliminate all 40 `Admitted` proofs in `psi_cdindex.v` by restoring proof bodies from `psi.v`.

**Context:**
- All .vo files are compiled (with Admitted stubs), so the project compiles.
- `psi_cdindex.v` imports: mmtree, psi_core, psi_comm, psi_descent
- `psi.v` contains the original working proofs for all lemmas
- Compilation: `coqc -native-compiler no -R . mathcomp_eulerian psi_cdindex.v`
- **We only have ~3GB RAM**, so be careful with 2 memory-bound proofs.

**The 40 Admitted lemmas:**

### Category A — Memory-bound (2 lemmas)
| Lemma | psi.v lines |
|---|---|
| has_left_child_order_iso | 4765–4836 |
| has_left_child_psi | 4838–4980 |

For these, add `Opaque` declarations and use `abstract(...)` to reduce memory.

### Category B — 38 smaller proofs
All proofs are in psi.v lines 4996–6605. Most are 5–50 lines.

**Common fix patterns needed:**
1. `perm_sort` type change in mathcomp 2.5: `exact: perm_sort leq s` → `by have /perm_eqlP := perm_sort leq s` or `rewrite perm_sort`
2. `addnS`/`addn1` rewrite direction may need flipping
3. `eq_in_filter` signature changes
4. `congr (_ ++ _)` may need `f_equal2` or manual rewrite

**Approach:**
1. Read psi_cdindex.v to find ALL 40 Admitted locations and their lemma names
2. For each lemma, find the corresponding proof in psi.v  
3. Restore proof bodies in batches (start with short proofs)
4. Apply known API fixes
5. Compile and iterate
6. Use rocq_start for interactive debugging of failures

Work systematically — restore all proofs first, then compile and fix errors iteratively. For the 2 memory-bound proofs, use aggressive Opaque/abstract strategies since we only have 3GB RAM.

1	(* psi_cdindex.v — Milestones 5+6: cd-index and support characterization     *)
2	(*                                                                           *)
3	(* Proves Fact #3 (cd-index via ψ) and constructs strict witnesses for the   *)
4	(* omega-monotonicity of β.                                                  *)
5	
6	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
7	Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm psi_descent.
8	
9	Set Implicit Arguments.
10	Unset Strict Implicit.
11	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
12	
13	(* ===== Milestone 5: Fact #3 — Φ_w(a+b, ab+ba) = Σ_{v∈[w]} u_{D(v)} ====== *)
14	(* Reference: M5_FACT3_INFORMAL.md (informal proof note).                      *)
15	(* Stanley EC1 (2nd ed.) section 1.6.3, Fact #3 (lines 294-329).              *)
16	(* The cd-index of w, evaluated at c:=a+b and d:=ab+ba, equals the sum of     *)
17	(* characteristic monomials u_{D(v)} over the M-equivalence class [w].        *)
18	
19	(* ----- M5.0 Definitions ----------------------------------------------------- *)
20	
21	(* Vertex i is internal (not an endpoint) iff it has window_size > 1. *)
22	Definition is_internal (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
23	  (i < size w) && (1 < window_size i w).
24	
25	(* Apply a sequence of psi operators left-to-right. *)
26	Definition apply_psis (ops : seq nat) (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=
27	  foldl (fun w' i => psi i w') w ops.
28	
29	(* Characteristic monomial: the seq of descent bits, true = b, false = a. *)
30	Definition char_mono (w : seq nat) : seq bool :=
31	  [seq is_descent_seq w k | k <- iota 0 (size w).-1].
32	
33	(* The cd-alphabet for classifying internal vertices. *)
34	Inductive cde := C_letter | D_letter | E_letter.
35	
36	Definition classify_vertex_cde (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : cde :=
37	  if ~~ is_internal i w then E_letter
38	  else if has_left_child i w then D_letter
39	  else C_letter.
40	
41	(* Φ'_w: the full classification string (one letter per vertex). *)
42	Definition phi'_w (w : seq nat) : seq cde :=
43	  [seq classify_vertex_cde i w | i <- iota 0 (size w)].
44	
45	(* Φ_w: delete endpoints (set e = 1, the empty word). *)
46	Definition phi_w (w : seq nat) : seq cde :=
47	  [seq x <- phi'_w w | match x with E_letter => false | _ => true end].
48	
49	(* The list of internal vertex positions, sorted. *)
50	Definition internal_vertices (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=
51	  [seq i <- iota 0 (size w) | is_internal i w].
52	
53	(* Expand a cd-word into the multiset of seq bool words.
54	   c = a + b expands to {[false], [true]}.
55	   d = ab + ba expands to {[false;true], [true;false]}. *)
56	Fixpoint expand_cde (letters : seq cde) : seq (seq bool) :=
57	  match letters with
58	  | [::] => [:: [::]]
59	  | C_letter :: rest =>
60	      let tails := expand_cde rest in
61	      [seq false :: t | t <- tails] ++ [seq true :: t | t <- tails]
62	  | D_letter :: rest =>
63	      let tails := expand_cde rest in
64	      [seq false :: true :: t | t <- tails] ++ [seq true :: false :: t | t <- tails]
65	  | E_letter :: rest => expand_cde rest
66	  end.
67	
68	(* Powerset of internal vertices (for enumerating the class). *)
69	Definition powerset_internal (w : seq nat) : seq (seq nat) :=
70	  let ivs := internal_vertices w in
71	  foldl (fun acc i => acc ++ [seq s ++ [:: i] | s <- acc]) [:: [::]] ivs.
72	
73	(* Lexicographic order on seq bool (for sorting multisets). *)
74	Fixpoint leq_seqb (s1 s2 : seq bool) : bool :=
75	  match s1, s2 with
76	  | [::], _ => true
77	  | _ :: _, [::] => false
78	  | b1 :: s1', b2 :: s2' =>
79	    if b1 == b2 then leq_seqb s1' s2'
80	    else ~~ b1
81	  end.
82	
83	(* ----- M5.1 Proved helpers -------------------------------------------------- *)
84	
85	Lemma apply_psis_nil w : apply_psis [::] w = w.
86	Proof. by []. Qed.
87	
88	Lemma apply_psis_cons i ops w :
89	  apply_psis (i :: ops) w = apply_psis ops (psi i w).
90	Proof. by []. Qed.
91	
92	Lemma size_apply_psis ops w : size (apply_psis ops w) = size w.
93	Proof.
94	elim: ops w => [// | i ops IH] w /=.
95	by rewrite IH size_psi.
96	Qed.
97	
98	Lemma uniq_apply_psis ops w : uniq w -> uniq (apply_psis ops w).
99	Proof.
100	elim: ops w => [// | i ops IH] w /= Hu.
101	by apply: IH; apply: uniq_psi.
102	Qed.
103	
104	Lemma perm_eq_apply_psis ops w : perm_eq (apply_psis ops w) w.
105	Proof.
106	elim: ops w => [| i ops IH] w /=; first exact: perm_refl.
107	exact: perm_trans (IH _) (psi_perm_eq _ _).
108	Qed.
109	
110	Lemma apply_psis_cat ops1 ops2 w :
111	  apply_psis (ops1 ++ ops2) w = apply_psis ops2 (apply_psis ops1 w).
112	Proof. by rewrite /apply_psis foldl_cat. Qed.
113	
114	Lemma apply_psis_rcons ops i w :
115	  apply_psis (rcons ops i) w = psi i (apply_psis ops w).
116	Proof. by rewrite -cats1 apply_psis_cat. Qed.
117	
118	(* ----- M5.2 Tree-shape invariance under psi -------------------------------- *)
119	(* window_size_psi is forward-declared above (before psi_comm_disjoint).      *)
120	(* has_left_child_psi: same invariance for has_left_child.                     *)
121	
122	(* Non-triviality: various j,i pairs on running example. *)
123	Example window_size_psi_ex1 :
124	  window_size 2 (psi 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6]) =
125	  window_size 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6].
126	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
127	
128	Example window_size_psi_ex2 :
129	  window_size 5 (psi 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6]) =
130	  window_size 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6].
131	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
132	
133	Example window_size_psi_ex3 :
134	  window_size 1 (psi 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6]) =
135	  window_size 1 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6].
136	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
137	
138	Lemma has_left_child_order_iso (s1 s2 : seq nat) i :
139	  size s1 = size s2 -> uniq s1 -> uniq s2 ->
140	  (forall p q, p < size s1 -> q < size s1 ->
141	    (nth 0 s1 p < nth 0 s1 q) =
142	    (nth 0 s2 p < nth 0 s2 q)) ->
143	  has_left_child i s1 = has_left_child i s2.
144	Proof. (* Structurally identical to window_size_order_iso; needs >16GB. *)
145	Admitted.
146	
147	Lemma has_left_child_psi : forall (j i : nat) (w : seq nat),
148	  uniq w -> has_left_child i (psi j w) = has_left_child i w.
149	Proof. (* Structurally identical to window_size_psi; needs >16GB. *)
150	Admitted.
151	
152	Example has_left_child_psi_ex :
153	  has_left_child 5 (psi 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6]) =
154	  has_left_child 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6].
155	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
156	
157	(* ----- M5.3 Free-endpoint lemma --------------------------------------------- *)
158	(* Every endpoint at position k with 0 <= k <= n-2 is the paired endpoint     *)
159	(* i-1 of some d-vertex i (i.e., vertex k+1 has both children). This ensures  *)
160	(* that the letter count of Phi_w(a+b, ab+ba) matches n-1.                    *)
161	(* Justification: M5_FACT3_INFORMAL.md section 3.5 (lines 470-502).           *)
162	(* The in-order successor of a leaf is always an ancestor with that leaf in    *)
163	(* its left subtree, hence has a left child. By property F1 (no left-only     *)
164	(* children in min-max trees), that ancestor is internal (has both children).  *)
165	
166	Lemma endpoint_implies_next_has_left_child :
167	  forall (k : nat) (w : seq nat),
168	    uniq w -> k.+1 < size w -> ~~ is_internal k w ->
169	    has_left_child k.+1 w.
170	Proof.
171	Admitted.
172	
173	Example endpoint_next_has_left_child_ex :
174	  (* Vertex 0 is endpoint in [3;1;5;4;2;6], vertex 1 has both children *)
175	  has_left_child 1 [:: 3; 1; 5; 4; 2; 6].
176	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
177	
178	Example endpoint_next_has_left_child_ex2 :
179	  (* Vertex 3 is endpoint in [3;1;5;4;2;6], vertex 4 has both children *)
180	  has_left_child 4 [:: 3; 1; 5; 4; 2; 6].
181	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
182	
183	(* ----- M5.4 Disjointness of affected position sets ------------------------ *)
184	(* For distinct internal vertices i and j, the affected descent-position sets *)
185	(* A(i) and A(j) are disjoint.  A(i) = {i} for Case R, A(i) = {i-1, i} for  *)
186	(* Case LR.  The key structural fact (Stanley EC1 line 259): if vertex i is   *)
187	(* Case LR, then vertex i-1 is an endpoint (hence not internal).             *)
188	
189	Lemma window_size_last_fuel :
190	  forall fuel w, size w <= fuel -> 0 < size w ->
191	  window_size_fuel fuel (size w).-1 w = 1.
192	Proof.
193	Admitted.
194	
195	Lemma window_size_last w :
196	  0 < size w ->
197	  window_size (size w).-1 w = 1.
198	Proof.
199	move=> Hne; rewrite /window_size.
200	exact: window_size_last_fuel (leqnn _) Hne.
201	Qed.
202	
203	Lemma LR_pred_is_endpoint :
204	  forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat),
205	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> is_internal i w ->
206	  has_left_child i w ->
207	  ~~ is_internal i.-1 w.
208	Proof.
209	Admitted.
210	
211	Example LR_pred_is_endpoint_ex :
212	  (* Vertex 1 is type d in [3;1;5;4;2;6]; vertex 0 is endpoint *)
213	  ~~ is_internal 0 [:: 3; 1; 5; 4; 2; 6].
214	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
215	
216	Example LR_pred_is_endpoint_ex2 :
217	  (* Vertex 4 is type d in [3;1;5;4;2;6]; vertex 3 is endpoint *)
218	  ~~ is_internal 3 [:: 3; 1; 5; 4; 2; 6].
219	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
220	
221	Example LR_pred_is_endpoint_ex3 :
222	  (* Vertex 5 is type d in [3;1;4;7;5;9;2;6]; vertex 4 is endpoint *)
223	  ~~ is_internal 4 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6].
224	Proof. by vm_compute. Qed.
225	
226	(* ----- M5.5 Main theorem: Fact #3 ------------------------------------------ *)
227	(* Φ_w(a+b, ab+ba) = Σ_{v∈[w]} u_{D(v)}.                                     *)
228	(* Proof: we show perm_eq between the two lists via an abstract               *)
229	(* factorization lemma on disjoint bit operations, then use sort equality.    *)
230	
231	(* -- Tree-shape invariance under apply_psis -------------------------------- *)
232	
233	Lemma window_size_apply_psis ops i w :
234	  uniq w ->
235	  window_size i (apply_psis ops w) = window_size i w.
236	Proof.
237	move=> Hu; elim: ops w Hu => [//|j ops IH] w Hu /=.
238	by rewrite IH ?uniq_psi // window_size_psi.
239	Qed.
240	
241	Lemma has_left_child_apply_psis ops i w :
242	  uniq w ->
243	  has_left_child i (apply_psis ops w) = has_left_child i w.
244	Proof.
245	move=> Hu; elim: ops w Hu => [//|j ops IH] w Hu /=.
246	by rewrite IH ?uniq_psi // has_left_child_psi.
247	Qed.
248	
249	Lemma is_internal_apply_psis ops i w :
250	  uniq w ->
251	  is_internal i (apply_psis ops w) = is_internal i w.
252	Proof.
253	move=> Hu; rewrite /is_internal size_apply_psis.
254	by rewrite window_size_apply_psis.
255	Qed.
256	
257	Lemma internal_vertices_apply_psis ops w :
258	  uniq w ->
259	  internal_vertices (apply_psis ops w) = internal_vertices w.
260	Proof.
261	move=> Hu; rewrite /internal_vertices size_apply_psis.
262	apply: eq_in_filter => i _.
263	exact: is_internal_apply_psis.
264	Qed.
265	
266	Lemma phi_w_apply_psis ops w :
267	  uniq w -> phi_w (apply_psis ops w) = phi_w w.
268	Proof.
269	move=> Hu; rewrite /phi_w /phi'_w size_apply_psis.
270	congr [seq _ <- _ | _].
271	apply: eq_map => i; rewrite /classify_vertex_cde.
272	by rewrite is_internal_apply_psis //
273	           has_left_child_apply_psis.
274	Qed.
275	
276	(* -- phi_w as a map over internal_vertices -------------------------------- *)
277	
278	Lemma phi_w_as_map w :
279	  phi_w w =
280	  [seq (if has_left_child i w then D_letter else C_letter)
281	  | i <- internal_vertices w].
282	Proof.
283	Admitted.
284	
285	(* -- Sorting infrastructure ----------------------------------------------- *)
286	
287	Lemma leq_seqb_trans : transitive leq_seqb.
288	Proof.
289	move=> y x z; elim: x y z =>
290	  [|b1 s1 IH] [|b2 s2] [|b3 s3] //=.
291	by case: b1; case: b2; case: b3 => //=; exact: IH.
292	Qed.
293	
294	Lemma leq_seqb_anti : antisymmetric leq_seqb.
295	Proof. Admitted.
296	
297	Lemma sort_perm_eq_leq_seqb (s1 s2 : seq (seq bool)) :
298	  perm_eq s1 s2 ->
299	  sort leq_seqb s1 = sort leq_seqb s2.
300	Proof.
301	Admitted.
302	
303	(* -- Descent effect of psi ----------------------------------------------- *)
304	
305	Lemma descent_psi_effect v w k :
306	  uniq w -> is_internal v w -> k < (size w).-1 ->
307	  is_descent_seq (psi v w) k =
308	    if ~~ has_left_child v w then
309	      if k == v then ~~ is_descent_seq w v
310	      else is_descent_seq w k
311	    else
312	      if k == v then is_descent_seq w v.-1
313	      else if k == v.-1 then is_descent_seq w v
314	      else is_descent_seq w k.
315	Proof.
316	Admitted.
317	
318	(* -- Char_mono tools ------------------------------------------------------ *)
319	
320	Lemma nth_char_mono w k :
321	  k < (size w).-1 ->
322	  nth false (char_mono w) k = is_descent_seq w k.
323	Proof.
324	move=> Hk; rewrite /char_mono (nth_map 0);
325	  last by rewrite size_iota.
326	by rewrite nth_iota // add0n.
327	Qed.
328	
329	Lemma size_char_mono w :
330	  size (char_mono w) = (size w).-1.
331	Proof. by rewrite /char_mono size_map size_iota. Qed.
332	
333	(* -- The last vertex has no left child ------------------------------------ *)
334	
335	Lemma has_left_child_last_fuel :
336	  forall fuel w, size w <= fuel -> 0 < size w ->
337	  has_left_child_fuel fuel (size w).-1 w = false.
338	Proof.
339	Admitted.
340	
341	Lemma has_left_child_last w :
342	  0 < size w ->
343	  has_left_child (size w).-1 w = false.
344	Proof.
345	move=> Hne; rewrite /has_left_child.
346	exact: has_left_child_last_fuel (leqnn _) Hne.
347	Qed.
348	
349	(* -- Penultimate vertex is internal --------------------------------------- *)
350	
351	Lemma last_vertex_internal w :
352	  uniq w -> 2 <= size w ->
353	  is_internal (size w).-2 w.
354	Proof.
355	Admitted.
356	
357	(* -- expand_cde rcons ----------------------------------------------------- *)
358	
359	Lemma expand_cde_rcons_C rest :
360	  expand_cde (rcons rest C_letter) =
361	  [seq s ++ [:: false] | s <- expand_cde rest] ++
362	  [seq s ++ [:: true] | s <- expand_cde rest].
363	Proof. Admitted.
364	
365	Lemma expand_cde_rcons_D rest :
366	  expand_cde (rcons rest D_letter) =
367	  [seq s ++ [:: false; true] | s <- expand_cde rest] ++
368	  [seq s ++ [:: true; false] | s <- expand_cde rest].
369	Proof. Admitted.
370	
371	(* -- fact3: helper infrastructure ---------------------------------------- *)
372	
373	(* has_left_child implies is_internal *)
374	Lemma has_left_child_is_internal i w :
375	  i < size w -> has_left_child i w -> is_internal i w.
376	Proof.
377	Admitted.
378	
379	(* Every endpoint k < (size w).-1 is the predecessor of a    *)
380	(* D-type internal vertex at k+1 (when w is uniq).            *)
381	Lemma endpoint_succ_is_D_internal k w :
382	  uniq w -> k.+1 < size w -> ~~ is_internal k w ->
383	  is_internal k.+1 w && has_left_child k.+1 w.
384	Proof.
385	move=> Hu Hk1 Hep.
386	have Hlc := endpoint_implies_next_has_left_child Hu Hk1 Hep.
387	by rewrite (has_left_child_is_internal Hk1 Hlc) Hlc.
388	Qed.
389	
390	(* -- expand_cde concatenation --------------------------------------------- *)
391	Lemma expand_cde_cat letters1 letters2 :
392	  expand_cde (letters1 ++ letters2) =
393	  flatten [seq [seq x ++ y | y <- expand_cde letters2]
394	          | x <- expand_cde letters1].
395	Proof.
396	Admitted.
397	
398	(* -- fact3: size lemmas --------------------------------------------------- *)
399	
400	Lemma size_powerset_of (ivs : seq nat) :
401	  size (foldl (fun acc i =>
402	    acc ++ [seq s ++ [:: i] | s <- acc]) [:: [::]] ivs)
403	  = 2 ^ size ivs.
404	Proof. Admitted.
405	
406	Lemma size_powerset_internal w :
407	  size (powerset_internal w) = 2 ^ size (internal_vertices w).
408	Proof. exact: size_powerset_of. Qed.
409	
410	Lemma size_expand_cde letters :
411	  size (expand_cde letters) =
412	  2 ^ size [seq l <- letters
413	           | match l with E_letter => false | _ => true end].
414	Proof. Admitted.
415	
416	Lemma size_phi_w w :
417	  size (phi_w w) = size (internal_vertices w).
418	Proof. by rewrite phi_w_as_map size_map. Qed.
419	
420	Lemma size_expand_cde_phi_w w :
421	  size (expand_cde (phi_w w)) =
422	  2 ^ size (internal_vertices w).
423	Proof.
424	Admitted.
425	
426	(* -- fact3: the proof ----------------------------------------------------- *)
427	(* We prove perm_eq between char_monos and expand_cde by showing:          *)
428	(*   (a) both lists have size 2^k  (k = |internal_vertices w|),           *)
429	(*   (b) every char_mono belongs to expand_cde (phi_w w), and             *)
430	(*   (c) the char_monos are pairwise distinct.                             *)
431	(* Together (a)-(c) with uniq(expand_cde) give perm_eq.                   *)
432	
433	(* -- (b) Membership: char_mono of apply_psis is in expand_cde ----------- *)
434	(* We prove this by induction on the cd-word (phi_w w), peeling off the    *)
435	(* FIRST letter and the first internal vertex simultaneously.               *)
436	
437	(* Helper: the sorted list of internal vertices starts with the first      *)
438	(* internal vertex.                                                        *)
439	(* The factored proof is deferred to a dedicated lemma below.             *)
440	
441	Definition check_fact3 (w : seq nat) : bool :=
442	  sort leq_seqb
443	    [seq char_mono (apply_psis ss w)
444	    | ss <- powerset_internal w]
445	  ==
446	  sort leq_seqb (expand_cde (phi_w w)).
447	
448	(* check_fact3 is correct by construction *)
449	Lemma check_fact3P w :
450	  reflect
451	    (sort leq_seqb
452	      [seq char_mono (apply_psis ss w)
453	      | ss <- powerset_internal w]
454	    =
455	    sort leq_seqb (expand_cde (phi_w w)))
456	    (check_fact3 w).
457	Proof. exact: eqP. Qed.
458	
459	(* check_fact3 is invariant under apply_psis *)
460	Lemma check_fact3_psi_invariant j w :
461	  uniq w -> check_fact3 (psi j w) = check_fact3 w.
462	Proof.
463	Admitted.

465	(* ---- Key decomposition at mm_pos -------------------------------------- *)
466	(* For w = take j w ++ [:: nth 0 w j] ++ drop j.+1 w  where j = mm_pos, *)
467	(* the multiset of char_monos factorizes as:                              *)

472	(*                                                                         *)
473	(* We prove this by establishing that:                                    *)

475	(*   powerset_internal w factors as product                               *)

485	(* Proof uses strong induction on size w with mm_pos decomposition.       *)
486	(* The core argument is that psi operations on the left/right subtrees    *)
487	(* act independently on disjoint descent positions, giving a product      *)
488	(* structure that matches expand_cde of the concatenated phi_w.           *)

491	(* We prove this by strong induction on size w.                   *)

603	(* ----- M6.1 The ω-map on seq nat ----------------------------------------- *)
604	(* ω(S) ⊆ [n−2]: position k ∈ ω(S) iff exactly one of k, k+1 belongs to S. *)
605	(* Mirrors omega_set in beta_swap.v but on seq nat (descent positions).       *)
606	
607	Definition omega_seq (s : seq nat) : seq nat :=
608	  [seq k <- iota 0 (foldr maxn 0 s).+1
609	   | (k \in s) != ((k.+1) \in s)].
610	
611	(* ----- M6.2 S_w: the d-position set --------------------------------------- *)
612	(* For the cd-string Φ'_w = f_0 ... f_{n-1}, define S_w = {i-1 : f_i = d}.  *)
613	(* Using the M5 definition classify_vertex_cde.                              *)
614	
615	Definition is_D_letter (l : cde) : bool :=
616	  match l with D_letter => true | _ => false end.
617	
618	Definition S_w_seq (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=
619	  [seq i.-1 | i <- iota 1 (size w).-1
620	             & is_D_letter (classify_vertex_cde i w)].

622	(* ----- M6.3 Support characterization -------------------------------------- *)
623	(* Stanley line 388: Φw(a+b, ab+ba) = Σ_{ω(X)⊇S_w} u_X.                    *)
624	(* u_X appears in the expansion iff every d-position of w is in ω(X).       *)
625	(*                                                                           *)
626	(* The support predicate: X ∈ expand_cde(Φ_w) iff S_w ⊆ ω(desc(X)).        *)
627	(* NOTE: the boolean equality requires size X = (size w).-1; without that    *)
628	(* hypothesis the RHS is vacuously true when S_w = ∅ and X has wrong length. *)
629	(* Verified exhaustively for all permutations up to S_7.                     *)
630	
631	Definition check_phi_w_support (w : seq nat) (X : seq bool) : bool :=
632	  (X \in expand_cde (phi_w w)) ==
633	  all (fun k => k \in omega_seq [seq i <- iota 0 (size w).-1 | nth false X i])
634	      (S_w_seq w).

675	(* ----- M6.4 Theorem 1.6.3 & Proposition 1.6.4 (seq-level) ---------------- *)
676	(* Thm 1.6.3: The cd-index Φₙ has nonneg integer coefficients (each         *)
677	(* M-class contributes one cd-monomial with coefficient 1).                  *)
678	(* Prop 1.6.4: ω(S) ⊂ ω(T) ⟹ β(S) < β(T).                                *)
679	(*                                                                           *)
680	(* Finset versions (using omega_set/beta from beta_swap.v/beta.v) cannot     *)
681	(* be stated here due to build order; they belong downstream.                *)
682	(* We capture the key content at seq level:                                  *)
683	(*   Weak: ω(S) ⊆ ω(T) ⟹ every M-class for β(S) also counts for β(T).     *)
684	(*   Strict: for k ∈ ω(T)\ω(S), the cd-word c^k d c^{n-3-k} witnesses      *)
685	(*     β(T) > β(S).  (Stanley lines 384-395.)                               *)
686	
687	(* Weak monotonicity (proved): if ω(S) ⊆ ω(T) as sets then every M-class
688	   whose d-positions are covered by ω(S) is also covered by ω(T). *)
689	Lemma omega_monotone_class_count (n : nat) (S T : seq nat) :
690	  uniq S -> uniq T ->
691	  {subset omega_seq S <= omega_seq T} ->
692	  (* Every M-class of perms of [1..n+1] counted by S is also counted by T *)
693	  forall (w : seq nat), uniq w -> size w = n ->
694	    all (fun k => k \in omega_seq S) (S_w_seq w) ->
695	    all (fun k => k \in omega_seq T) (S_w_seq w).
696	Proof.
697	move=> _ _ Hsub w _ _ /allP Hall.
698	by apply/allP => k Hk; apply: Hsub; apply: Hall.
699	Qed.
700	
701	(* Strict witness: for any k, the cd-word c^k d c^{m-k} has S_w = {k}.
702	   Therefore if k ∈ ω(T)\ω(S), there is a class contributing to β(T) but
703	   not β(S). This is Stanley's argument (line 394-395). *)
704

5696	(* be the same multiset as char_monos over subsets applied to w.*)
5697	(* This uses psi_comm to reorder the psi applications.          *)
5698	congr (sort leq_seqb _).

5701	(* apply_psis ss (psi j w) applies psis from ss to psi j w. *)
5702	(* The result is psi_{s_k} ... psi_{s_1} psi_j w. *)
5703	(* By psi_comm and psi_involutive, this is a member of [w]. *)
5704	(* But we need it to equal char_mono(apply_psis ss' w) for some ss'. *)

5706	(* (by definition of apply_psis). So the char_mono is the same *)
5707	(* as for subset [j] ++ ss applied to w. *)

5711	(* In that case, check_fact3 (psi j w) = check_fact3 w trivially. *)

5714	(* is a GROUP acting on w, and the group action gives the same *)

5746	(* Proof uses strong induction on size w with mm_pos decomposition.       *)
5747	(* The core argument is that psi operations on the left/right subtrees    *)
5748	(* act independently on disjoint descent positions, giving a product      *)
5749	(* structure that matches expand_cde of the concatenated phi_w.           *)

5752	(* We prove this by strong induction on size w.                   *)
5753	(* Base: size <= 1, check_fact3_size1.                            *)
5754	(* Step: decompose at mm_pos into L and R (both smaller).         *)
5755	(*   - check_fact3 L holds by IH.                                *)
5756	(*   - check_fact3 R holds by IH.                                *)
5757	(*   - check_fact3 w follows from the factored descent argument   *)

5760	  uniq w -> check_fact3 w.

5764	  uniq w -> check_fact3 w.

5790	     rewrite ltnNge Hszn.

5801	(*   expand_cde decomposes as a product (expand_cde_cat)   *)
5802	(*   powerset_internal w decomposes as a product           *)
5803	(*   char_monos decompose with L-prefix ++ root ++ R-suffix *)
5804	(*   psi operations on L/R/root are independent             *)
5805	(*   The product of the three parts matches.                *)
5806	(*                                                          *)

5808	(* descent_psi_effect for locality, and the tree shape      *)
5809	(* lemmas window_size_cons, has_left_child_cons for         *)
5810	(* decomposing classify_vertex_cde at mm_pos.               *)
5811	by rewrite /check_fact3 /apply_psis /=.

5987	(* Thm 1.6.3: The cd-index Φₙ has nonneg integer coefficients (each         *)

5989	(* Prop 1.6.4: ω(S) ⊂ ω(T) ⟹ β(S) < β(T).                                *)

5991	(* Finset versions (using omega_set/beta from beta_swap.v/beta.v) cannot     *)
5992	(* be stated here due to build order; they belong downstream.                *)
5993	(* We capture the key content at seq level:                                  *)
5994	(*   Weak: ω(S) ⊆ ω(T) ⟹ every M-class for β(S) also counts for β(T).     *)
5995	(*   Strict: for k ∈ ω(T)\ω(S), the cd-word c^k d c^{n-3-k} witnesses      *)

5998	(* Weak monotonicity (proved): if ω(S) ⊆ ω(T) as sets then every M-class
5999	   whose d-positions are covered by ω(S) is also covered by ω(T). *)
6000	Lemma omega_monotone_class_count (n : nat) (S T : seq nat) :
6001	  uniq S -> uniq T ->
6002	  {subset omega_seq S <= omega_seq T} ->
6003	  (* Every M-class of perms of [1..n+1] counted by S is also counted by T *)
6004	  forall (w : seq nat), uniq w -> size w = n ->
6005	    all (fun k => k \in omega_seq S) (S_w_seq w) ->
6006	    all (fun k => k \in omega_seq T) (S_w_seq w).
6007	Proof.
6008	move=> _ _ Hsub w _ _ /allP Hall.
6009	by apply/allP => k Hk; apply: Hsub; apply: Hall.
6010	Qed.

6012	(* Strict witness: for any k, the cd-word c^k d c^{m-k} has S_w = {k}.
6013	   Therefore if k ∈ ω(T)\ω(S), there is a class contributing to β(T) but
6014	   not β(S). This is Stanley's argument (line 394-395). *)

  forall n s1 s2 i, size s1 <= n ->
  size s1 = size s2 -> uniq s1 -> uniq s2 ->
  (forall p q, p < size s1 -> q < size s1 ->
    (nth 0 s1 p < nth 0 s1 q) =
    (nth 0 s2 p < nth 0 s2 q)) ->
  has_left_child i s1 = has_left_child i s2.
Proof.
elim=> [|n IH] s1 s2 i Hsz1 Hszeq Hu1 Hu2 Hord.
  have Hsz0 : size s1 = 0
    by apply/eqP; rewrite -leqn0.
  by rewrite (size0nil Hsz0); rewrite Hsz0 in
     Hszeq; rewrite (size0nil (esym Hszeq)).
case Hs1 : s1 => [|a1 t1]; first
  by move: Hszeq; rewrite Hs1 /= => Hsz2;
     have -> : s2 = [::] by apply/eqP;
     rewrite -size_eq0 -Hsz2.
case Hs2 : s2 => [|a2 t2]; first
  by move: Hszeq; rewrite Hs1 Hs2 /=.
have Hne1 : a1 :: t1 <> [::] by [].
have Hne2 : a2 :: t2 <> [::] by [].
have Hszeq' : size (a1 :: t1) = size (a2 :: t2)
  by rewrite -Hs1 -Hs2.
subst s1 s2.
have Hmm := mm_pos_order_iso Hszeq' Hu1 Hu2
